items.title: Amer Fort
items.description: 11km north of Jaipur, this 16th-century hilltop fort complex is Jaipur's most visited landmark. Features the ornate Sheesh Mahal (Hall of Mirrors), Diwan-i-Aam, Sukh Niwas and panoramic Aravalli views. Accessible by foot, jeep or elephant ride from the main gate. ASI-protected UNESCO site. Budget 2–3 hours.
items.reasoning: Start the morning fresh at the iconic 16th-century Amer Fort in northern Jaipur.

items.title: Jal Mahal
items.description: 18th-century palace appearing to float in the centre of Man Sagar Lake, 6km north of Jaipur on the Amer road. Palace interior is not open to visitors; the attraction is the view from the lakeside gardens and road. Best photographed at sunrise or sunset. Free viewpoint from the lake embankment.
items.reasoning: Quick stop nearby to view the stunning floating Jal Mahal on the Amer Road.

items.title: Galta Ji (Monkey Temple)
items.description: Complex of Hindu temples and kunds (natural water tanks) built into a mountain gorge 10km east of Jaipur. Home to hundreds of rhesus macaques. Features Galta temple, Surya Mandir and an old haveli. Free entry; steep path with 200+ stairs. Best visited in the morning when monkeys are most active.
items.reasoning: Morning visit to Galta Ji (Monkey Temple) when the rhesus macaques are most active.

items.title: Johari Bazaar
items.description: Jaipur's main jewellery street in the old walled city (Old Town), famous for gold, gems and kundan/meenakari jewellery. Also the best viewpoint for photographing Hawa Mahal from across the street. Lined with traditional havelis; busy during morning hours. Free to browse.
items.reasoning: Stroll through Johari Bazaar for jewellery shopping and classic Hawa Mahal views.

items.title: Jaipur Street Food Walk
items.description: Johari Bazaar and Bapu Bazaar areas host Jaipur's best street food: kachori-sabzi, mirchi bada (chilli fritter), pyaz kachori, dahi jalebi, and Rajasthani ghevar (lattice sweet). Best explored on foot in the late morning.
items.reasoning: Indulge in a Jaipur Street Food Walk around the Old City bazaars for lunch.
